candidates.title: Data for "Probing stress and magnetism at high pressures with two-dimensional quantum sensors"
candidates.source_author_assignments_available: reported zone axes only; reflection inventory not yet audited
source_evidence: The official DataCORE landing page reports raw TEM diffraction data for chromium telluride nanoplates.
The methodology states that SAED patterns were recorded along [001] and [112] zone axes.
The description states that diffraction data are supplied as TIFF images and original Gatan DM4 files.
The record has DOI 10.5967/ct7n-8275 and a CC BY 4.0 license.
blocking_evidence: The landing page does not expose an archive checksum or per-member checksums.
Accelerating voltage, camera length, detector metadata, pattern center, immutable sample IDs, and acquisition IDs are not established by the landing-page metadata.
The independence of the two stated zone-axis patterns has not been verified.
The DM4-to-TIFF relationship and preservation of original intensity values have not been audited.
candidates.next_validation_step: Download Diffraction_Pattern.zip through the DataCORE file panel, bind the archive and every member by SHA-256, inspect DM4 metadata without modifying arrays, compare DM4 and TIFF representations, and verify at least two independent acquisitions before creating a real-data validation case.

registry_decision.next_action: perform checksum-bound raw-file and metadata audit
registry_decision.scientific_boundary: Do not tune center, smoothing, prominence, radius bounds, or candidate count against the reported zone axes. No phase, reflection, zone-axis, d-spacing accuracy, or engineering claim is allowed before the raw-file audit and protocol freeze.
